# Palladium Magazine

> > Palladium Magazine is a non-partisan publication focused on governance, geopolitics, and investigative journalism with deep coverage of global affairs.

Palladium offers both a digital magazine and The Palladium Letter, a weekly newsletter exploring governance challenges across regions including Xinjiang, Kazakhstan, Venezuela, and Ukraine. The publication provides investigative reporting and analysis comparable to outlets like Foreign Affairs, The Atlantic, and Foreign Policy.

## Key Topics

- Governance
- Geopolitics
- Investigative journalism
- The Palladium Letter (weekly newsletter)
- Non-partisan analysis
- Xinjiang
- Kazakhstan
- Venezuela
- Ukraine
- Print magazine
- Foreign policy
- Global affairs
- Subscription content
